info.title: bitbucket
info.description: Bitbucket Cloud REST API v2.0 for repository, PR, issue, and tag workflows

get.summary: Get repository metadata including default branch and workspace info
get.description: Get repository metadata including default branch and workspace info

get.summary: Get a directory listing (paginated JSON of SourceEntry) or the raw content of a file at a specific commit
get.description: Get a directory listing (paginated JSON of SourceEntry) or the raw content of a file at a specific commit

200.description:
Successful response

application/json: returned for a directory: its paginated listing. Bitbucket serves a file in the media type its name implies, so a committed `.json` file also arrives as `application/json` and selects this shape: a JSON object decodes as an empty listing, other JSON fails to decode. No header tells the two apart; read a file's bytes with `send_raw`

*/*: returned for a file: its raw content, in the media type Bitbucket derives from the file name

success.note: returned for a directory: its paginated listing. Bitbucket serves a file in the media type its name implies, so a committed `.json` file also arrives as `application/json` and selects this shape: a JSON object decodes as an empty listing, other JSON fails to decode. No header tells the two apart; read a file's bytes with `send_raw`
returned for a file: its raw content, in the media type Bitbucket derives from the file name

PaginatedResponse<SourceEntry>.title: PaginatedResponse
PaginatedResponse<SourceEntry>.description:
A paginated response wrapper.

Bitbucket uses cursor-based pagination. Follow the `next` URL to get more results.

next.description: URL to the next page of results, if any.

previous.description: URL to the previous page of results, if any.

size.description: Total number of items across all pages.

CommitInfo.description: Simple commit info embedded in other types.

SourceEntry.description:
A source entry from directory listing.

Returned by `GET /repositories/{workspace}/{repo_slug}/src/{commit}/{path}`.

links.description: HATEOAS links including "self" for raw content.

A download artifact from `GET /repositories/{workspace}/{repo_slug}/downloads`.

Downloads serve as release artifacts in Bitbucket (there's no first-class release concept).
